name: submit_analysis
description: Submit the structured result of the weekly portfolio rebalance analysis. The summary and markdownBody are the human-readable narrative; orders is the machine-actionable list of buy/sell suggestions. All fields are required.

summary.description: One-paragraph executive summary of the week's recommended action. Plain prose, no markdown. Visible on the dashboard list page.

markdownBody.description: Full narrative report in markdown. Must include sections: Executive Summary, Market Context (with current riesgo país reading and its relation to the 600 bp trigger), Portfolio Assessment, Week-over-week Comparison (omitted on first run), Suggested Actions. Renders on the dashboard detail page.

orders.description: Structured list of suggested buy/sell orders. Empty array is valid when the analysis concludes no action is warranted.

broker.description: Target broker for the order. Must match an existing broker record.

symbol.description: Instrument symbol as the broker would recognize it (e.g., BRK.B, GD41D, SGOV).

side.description: buy or sell. There is no 'hold' value — hold-style commentary belongs in markdownBody, not here.

quantity.description: Positive quantity in the instrument's natural unit (shares for equities/ETFs, nominales for bonds, etc.).

rationale.description: One or two sentences justifying the order, citing at least one of: allocation drift, a standing position-level directive, an active trigger condition (e.g., riesgo país threshold), or new market context. ARS-denominated orders must acknowledge commission + IVA. Keep it concise.

conviction.description: Self-rated confidence in the suggestion. 'high' is required to propose >25% portfolio rotation in a single week.

watchlist.description: Feature 010: rule-triggered flags — holdings or topics a standing rule or condition surfaced this week. OMIT this field entirely if nothing is flagged. Do NOT restate the bucket/asset-class drift or concentration-cap tables here; those are computed separately and rendered for you.

trigger.description: The rule or condition that fired (e.g. 'riesgo país > 600 bp', 'sector concentration directive').

weekOverWeek.description: Feature 010: ANALYTICAL changes since last week — metrics/assessments, NOT raw position quantity changes (those are computed and shown separately). OMIT on first run or when nothing material changed.

prior.description: Prior value as a short string (allows %, words, or numbers).

frameworkAmendments.description: Feature 010: suggested changes to the strategic framework, if any. OMIT if none. These are suggestions for the owner to consider — they are not applied automatically.
